title: Daniel Lambert (@dlLambo) on X
excerpt: Netanyahu: "I can penetrate this machine (a smartphone) and make you out to be a monster. And if I say it enough people believe it." He doest even hide it. A global Zionist network of espionage, sabotage and lies to keep killing kids and stealing lands.
